title: Predicting Ocean Acidification from Atmospheric CO2
description: Final project for a Machine Learning course: clustering, PCA, and classification models (Naive Bayes, Decision Trees, XGBoost) applied to 30+ years of BATS oceanographic data to study the link between atmospheric CO2 and ocean alkalinity.

title: Applications of Neural Networks in Continuous and Dynamic Systems
description: With Sean Fitzgerald — comparing an autoregressive MLP, RNN, LSTM, Transformer, Neural ODE, and Neural Jump ODE on their ability to recover the latent dynamics of non-stationary, regime-switching stochastic processes.
